_comment: Every source used by this project, with the exact URL that is read and what it is allowed to supply. 'role' states the only permitted use.

sources.name: HotSpawn - League of Legends Pick'em lobby
sources.role: Which matches exist, lock times, tier, points and the permalink HotSpawn publishes. Never used as a probability signal.

sources.name: HotSpawn public fixtures API (LoL)
sources.kind: fixture inventory (HotSpawn public API used by its own lobby)
sources.role: Complete machine-readable fixture list. Never used as a probability signal.

sources.name: Kalshi - League of Legends game markets (series KXLOLGAME)
sources.kind: prediction market regulated by the US CFTC
sources.role: External price for a single game. De-vigged and labelled as a map price when no series price exists.

sources.name: Polymarket - League of Legends markets
sources.role: External match-winner price for a series (the best-of format is part of the market title).

sources.name: Pinnacle - E Sports board (public guest API)
sources.role: External moneyline for series (period 0) and single maps (period 1).

sources.name: Bovada - esports events feed
sources.role: External moneyline per market period (game or series).

sources.name: Leaguepedia - League of Legends esports wiki
sources.kind: community wiki (the de-facto LoL esports results database)
sources.role: Verified match results used to fit our own line. Every row that uses it links to the exact wiki page.

sources.name: Leaguepedia Cargo API (action=cargoquery)
sources.role: Would have been the fastest structured results source; it is rate limited for anonymous callers, so the rendered pages are used instead.

sources.name: Sofascore API
sources.role: Evaluated as an additional results source for the low-tier leagues; the API refuses requests from our runner (HTTP 403).

sources.name: Liquipedia - League of Legends
sources.role: Evaluated as a cross-check source; refuses requests from our runner (HTTP 403).

sources.name: Oracle's Elixir downloadable match data
sources.role: Evaluated as a source of game-level results for the top leagues; the bucket returned HTTP 404 for the 2025 and 2026 files.

sources.name: Games of Legends
sources.role: Evaluated as a results source; its database covers the major leagues only (53 of the 189 teams on the HotSpawn board).
